name: Sakuma Sakuzo
source:
Kyouichi's father. Close friends with the Kamishiro family. Works as a lawyer and wants Kyouichi to be a lawyer as well.

Left on bitter terms when Kyouichi decided he didn't want to be forced into a lawyer career and moved in with the Kamishiro family.
